provenance_note: Original heuristic wording authored for this prototype. Public architecture links are design context, not empirical proofs or quotations.

principles.statement: A good principle says when it would stop being good.
principles.applies_when: A claim is treated as a durable rule.
principles.limitation: Some ethical commitments are values, not falsifiable empirical predictions.
principles.next_test: Find a concrete counterexample and record whether the principle changes.

principles.statement: Complexity becomes useful only when a newcomer can cross it.
principles.applies_when: Visitors face unfamiliar concepts or many paths.
principles.limitation: Some specialists legitimately require substantial training.
principles.next_test: Compare uncoached first-use success against the plain existing doorway.

principles.statement: A recurring task is not automated until it keeps its promise without rescue.
principles.applies_when: Reports or reviews require repeated manual relay.
principles.limitation: Human review can be intentionally mandatory for consequential actions.
principles.next_test: Miss a scheduled run and independently verify recovery and receiver effect.

principles.statement: A thousand workers without a useful handoff are one expensive distraction.
principles.applies_when: Many agents are active but outcomes stall.
principles.limitation: Parallel exploration can be valuable before a direct handoff is possible.
principles.next_test: Measure independently accepted closures per budget, not agent count.

principles.statement: Publishing a result makes it addressable, not necessarily noticed.
principles.applies_when: Repository links or posts are mistaken for adoption.
principles.limitation: Public release is still valuable even before a receiver responds.
principles.next_test: Seek opt-in external first-use readproof and record nonresponse honestly.

principles.statement: A smaller view stays faithful when its omissions can be inspected.
principles.applies_when: A graph or work object is reduced to a compact CoOrb.
principles.limitation: Intentional deletion, revoked access, and lossy summaries prevent full restoration.
principles.next_test: Collapse and expand a pinned object and compare provenance and permissions.

principles.statement: Permission belongs to a particular effect, not to a pleasing interface.
principles.applies_when: A role, persona, or model proposes an action.
principles.limitation: Some public read-only operations require no personal grant.
principles.next_test: Attempt an out-of-scope action and prove fail-closed behavior.

principles.statement: A prediction is a question offered early, not an action performed early.
principles.applies_when: A model or UI predicts the next input or recipient.
principles.limitation: Safe, explicitly authorized prefetch may be useful when it has no external effect.
principles.next_test: Change the input after a suggestion and confirm no stale dispatch or hidden paste.

principles.statement: Independence is demonstrated by a loss survived, not an alternate URL listed.
principles.applies_when: Several links or mirrors are treated as separate failure domains.
principles.limitation: A backup need not run continuously to be useful.
principles.next_test: Recover one exact public artifact outside its original provider and check usable state.

principles.statement: Retained disagreement is raw material for a better successor.
principles.applies_when: Reviewers or models disagree about a claim.
principles.limitation: Repeated unsupported objections can waste scarce attention.
principles.next_test: Log one serious challenger objection and test which revision survives.

principles.statement: When a predecessor did it better, the next version should learn rather than rename.
principles.applies_when: A new feature overlaps older code, theory, or outside prior art.
principles.limitation: A genuinely new implementation can still add value with measurable differences.
principles.next_test: Pin both versions and compare real first-use outcomes, cost, and recovery.

principles.statement: A trustworthy invitation makes the exit as clear as the entrance.
principles.applies_when: A visitor is asked to install, enroll, share or contribute.
principles.limitation: Exit may require a legally mandated retention period; explain it rather than hide it.
principles.next_test: Uninstall or revoke a demo and verify which state is still kept.

principles.statement: What cannot be measured should remain a question, not become a green light.
principles.applies_when: A dashboard lacks independent evidence for a reassuring claim.
principles.limitation: Action under uncertainty may still be warranted when risks and limits are explicit.
principles.next_test: Replace one false-green with a visible UNKNOWN and compare decision quality.

principles.statement: An evergreen system must know when to sleep, stop and be replaced.
principles.applies_when: Continuous evolution is mistaken for continuous execution.
principles.limitation: Critical safety monitors may require genuinely continuous uptime.
principles.next_test: Prove dormancy, wake criteria, bounded budget and a successor handoff.

typed_relations.reason: Clarity may require compression, but too much hides evidence.
A team is useful only if completed work reaches a receiver.
A published link needs a newcomer-usable path.
Predictions do not create action authority.
Priors are a form of independent challenge.
Dormancy is safe only when restoration is trustworthy.
Admitting uncertainty makes a rule challengeable.
Outreach cannot manufacture a lock-in obligation.
